decision.rationale: The candidate preserved the highest observed development quality and improved median latency by about 24%, but its 61.92-second p95 failed the 10-second deployment gate. Keep M3 in the research comparison but do not freeze this runtime for deployment.
limitations: Development evidence does not support a held-out generalization claim.
Boundary thresholds were calibrated and measured on the same five cases.
Fixed execution order makes workstation latency descriptive rather than a capacity result.
